cases.sentence: Только они ушли за маслом, пришел ___.
cases.translation: Only they went away to buy oil, the bridegroom came.
cases.explain: Жених is the subject of пришёл (came) — nominative.

cases.sentence: Тогда будет как у того ___, который, отправляясь в далекое путешествие, созвал своих слуг и поручил им свое имущество.
cases.translation: It will be like that man who, going on a long journey, called his servants and entrusted them with his property.
cases.explain: The preposition у (at, belonging to) takes the genitive → человека.

cases.sentence: «Смотри», — сказал он ___, — «ты доверил мне пять талантов, и я выручил еще пять».
cases.translation: “Look,” he said to the master, “you entrusted me with five talents, and I have gained five more.”
cases.explain: Сказал (кому?) takes an indirect object in the dative → хозяину.

cases.sentence: Тогда небесное царство будет подобно десяти девушкам, которые, взяв свои лампы, вышли встречать ___.
cases.translation: ...who, taking their lamps, went out to meet the bridegroom.
cases.explain: Встречать (to meet) takes a direct object; жених is animate masculine, so its accusative form matches the genitive: жениха.

cases.sentence: Девушки с зажженными ___ вошли с ним на свадебный пир, и дверь за ними закрылась.
cases.translation: The girls with their lamps lit went in with him to the wedding feast, and the door was shut behind them.
cases.explain: The preposition с (with) takes the instrumental → лампами.

cases.sentence: Я был в ___, и вы пришли навестить меня.
cases.translation: I was in prison, and you came to visit me.
cases.explain: The preposition в showing location (not motion) takes the prepositional → темнице.

reading.ru: Тогда небесное царство будет подобно десяти девушкам, которые, взяв свои лампы, вышли встречать жениха.
reading.question: What did the ten virgins take with them to meet the bridegroom?
reading.explain: The parable says they took their lamps and went out to meet the bridegroom.

reading.ru: Глупые девушки взяли лампы, но не взяли для них масла, а умные вместе с лампами взяли и масло в кувшинах.
reading.question: What mistake did the foolish virgins make?
options: They took no oil for their lamps
reading.correct: They took no oil for their lamps
reading.explain: The foolish virgins took lamps but no oil, while the wise took oil in jars along with their lamps.

reading.ru: Около полуночи раздался крик «Жених идет! Выходите встречать его!»
reading.question: When did the cry announcing the bridegroom's arrival come?
reading.explain: “About midnight there was a cry: ‘The bridegroom is coming! Come out to meet him!’”

reading.ru: Только они ушли за маслом, пришел жених.
reading.question: What happened while the foolish virgins were away buying oil?
reading.explain: While they were gone to buy oil, the bridegroom came.

reading.ru: Девушки с зажженными лампами вошли с ним на свадебный пир, и дверь за ними закрылась.
reading.question: What happened to the door after the ready virgins entered the feast?
reading.explain: They went in with him to the wedding feast, and the door was shut behind them.

reading.ru: Одному он дал пять талантов, другому два, третьему один, каждому по его способностям, а сам уехал.
reading.question: How did the master decide how many talents to give each servant?
reading.explain: He gave talents to each servant according to his own ability.

reading.ru: А тот, который получил один талант, пошел, вырыл яму и закопал деньги, которые ему доверил хозяин.
reading.question: What did the servant with one talent do with it?
options: He dug a hole and buried it
He invested it and doubled it
He gave it to the poor
reading.correct: He dug a hole and buried it
reading.explain: The servant with one talent dug a hole in the ground and buried the money entrusted to him.

reading.ru: «Смотри», — сказал он хозяину, — «ты доверил мне пять талантов, и я выручил еще пять».
reading.question: What did the servant who received five talents report to his master?
options: He had gained five more talents
He had given the money away
reading.correct: He had gained five more talents
reading.explain: He told his master he had turned five talents into five more.

reading.ru: Выбросьте этого негодного слугу вон, во тьму, где будет плач и скрежет зубов.
reading.question: What punishment did the master order for the worthless servant?
options: To be thrown outside into the darkness
To be sent to buy oil
reading.correct: To be thrown outside into the darkness
reading.explain: The master ordered the worthless servant thrown outside into the darkness, where there would be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

reading.ru: Овец он соберет по правую сторону от себя, а козлов по левую.
reading.question: How will the Son of Man separate the sheep and the goats?
options: Sheep on his right, goats on his left
Goats on his right, sheep on his left
Sheep in heaven, goats already punished
reading.correct: Sheep on his right, goats on his left
reading.explain: He will gather the sheep to his right and the goats to his left.

reading.ru: и они пойдут в вечное наказание, а праведники — в вечную жизнь.
reading.question: What is the final destiny described for the two groups?
options: Eternal punishment for one group, eternal life for the righteous
They are given a second chance
reading.correct: Eternal punishment for one group, eternal life for the righteous
reading.explain: The chapter ends: they will go away into eternal punishment, but the righteous into eternal life.
